$description: WOLF OVERRIDE UI tokens: the one home for UI colour, type, density, motion and timing (brief 2.7). The game (UiTokens, apps/game/scripts/ui_tokens.gd) and the HTML mockups (mockups/shared/wo.js) read this file; scripts/export_ui_tokens.py writes each token's theme slots, and default_font_size from type.body.size, into assets/fonts/game_theme.tres. Format: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. An alias is {group.token}. Units: a dimension's px is a canvas px of the 960x540 canvas; durations are in ms; min, max, step, hard_min, hard_max and band use the unit of the token's value; hard limits are inclusive. A number token with options is a choice: its $value is the index into options. For colour, font family and font weight tokens, options lists the allowed values. status: sourced (a cited number), computed (arithmetic from cited numbers; read-only), today (the game's current value) or proposal (a design choice to tune). Entry rule: a value enters only in the change that deletes its last other copy, or as a new proposal nothing else holds. Kept out, one home each: reading_cps and row_characters (i18n/languages.json), box metrics and gradients (game_theme.tres), the canvas size (project.godot), world colours (scripts/fx/palette.gd), scene and script colour literals until B26, and in-play feel constants (impact.gd, main.gd).

color.$description: UI colours: base colours (what exists) and roles (what each theme slot means).

base.$description: Every colour the theme draws today, each written once (C2 Table B). Only theme-bound colours live here; scene and script colour literals stay in their files until B26 moves them into theme type variations. Colours are never free to tune (N2): a role picks among existing base colours.

role.$description: What each theme slot means. Theme slots and code read roles, never base colours. Each role names the theme slots it fills (theme); scripts/export_ui_tokens.py writes them.

control.$description: Rounded menu buttons (Button) and the states every button family shares.

focus.$description: The focus ring every control shares (B7).

touch.$description: On-screen touch buttons (TouchButton: arrows, USE, PAUSE, answers).

terminal.$description: The Settings terminal look: square buttons, tabs, the surface panel and drop-down menus.

hud-card.$description: HudCard: the play HUD's cards (top card, dialogue, hint, tutorial).

menu-panel.$description: MenuPanel: pause, credits, changelog and end card.

type.$description: Type roles (2.2, fixes B5). A role's size in canvas px = round(size x profile text-scale x TEXT SIZE), the same rounding as TextSize.px. Floors are per profile (profile.*.text-min).

display.$description: The title WOLF OVERRIDE only. 42 is today's title size; this token becomes its home.

h1.$description: Screen titles (SYSTEM SETTINGS, SESSION PAUSED). 2x Body, like Apple's ramp.

line-height.$description: Two-line dialogue box. Blocks of 3 or more lines use type.body.line-height.

body.$description: Control text, notes, prompt pill, objective. Its size is also the theme's default_font_size.

size.$description: Also written to game_theme.tres default_font_size by scripts/export_ui_tokens.py.

contrast.$description: Contrast minimums against the worst patch behind the text (XAG102).

large.$description: Ratio for large text and disabled text.

large-size.$description: Text this size and up counts as large.

density.$description: Control sizes (2.3, fixes B6): row and button height, minimum hit area and gaps, in canvas px unless a unit is named.

pointer.$description: Row and button height with mouse, keyboard or pad on desktop.

handheld.$description: Row and button height on the ROG Ally and other handheld PCs, all inputs. 7.5 mm needs at least 47 canvas px on the Ally (0.1614 mm each).

phone.$description: Computed at run time as the larger of density.phone-min-pt and density.phone-min-dp on the device; 58 is the iPhone 14 Pro Max result (46 pt, 7.7 mm).

phone-min-pt.$description: Phone touch target minimum, in points (iOS).

phone-min-dp.$description: Phone touch target minimum, in dp (Android): 48 x screen_get_dpi() / 160 device px, never screen_get_scale().

phone-minor-pt.$description: Minor phone targets, in points (35 canvas px on the iPhone 14 Pro Max).

touch-floor.$description: Touch density never goes below the pointer row (44 pt is only 30.9 canvas px on the iPad Air 13).

pointer-hit-min.$description: Smallest hit area with a mouse.

gap-phone-dp.$description: Gap between targets on phones, in dp (10 canvas px on the iPhone 14 Pro Max).

label-gap.$description: Gap between a control and its label.

edge-pad.$description: From a panel edge to its text.

touch-switch.$description: When the desktop profile switches to handheld density after a real touch: off, at the next screen open (rows never jump under the finger) or at once. Index into options.

control-share.$description: Share of a settings row's width the control column takes, the same on every page, so every control and slider starts at one x (3.1).

com.mrdemonwolf.wolfoverride.source: brief 3.1 (M08, M09 and M10 asked for one value column)

profile.$description: Per-device-class defaults (2.4). The profile changes defaults and density, never access. Input presentation follows the last input; the profile only sets first-launch defaults.

hud-margin.$description: HUD distance from the screen edges on desktop and handheld; phones use the OS safe area.

desktop.$description: Mac and Windows: mouse, keyboard, optional pad.

text-min.$description: Body height floor: 18 px at 1080p (macOS 10 pt is 7.5 canvas px, lower, and UNVERIFIED). Floors are body heights; Godot's font_size is the em, ratio UNVERIFIED (2.1).

handheld.$description: ROG Ally (2023) and other handheld PCs: built-in Xbox-layout pad first, 10-point touch.

text-size.$description: TEXT SIZE default on handhelds, in percent (Make the fonts larger).

text-min.$description: Body height floor: 14 px at 1080p (Steam Deck: 6.75).

tv-margin-y.$description: Optional top and bottom margin when docked to a TV.

tv-margin-x.$description: Optional side margin when docked to a TV.

settings-frame.$description: Settings in the desktop card or full screen inside the safe area. Index into options.

phone.$description: iPhone, iPad and Android: touch first, optional pad.

text-scale.$description: Computed per device: max(text-scale-min, body-pt / (type.body.size x pt per canvas px)). 1.334 is the iPhone 14 Pro Max result; the iPad Air 13 stays 1.0. Android matches the iPhone's physical Body (2.82 mm; 1.48 on the Pixel 8).

text-scale-min.$description: Floor of the phone text scale, so a tablet never shrinks menus.

body-pt.$description: Body size on phones, in points (Apple's iOS default).

text-min-pt.$description: Smallest text on phones, in points.

settings-frame.$description: Settings in the desktop card or full screen inside the safe area. Index into options.

use-size-mm.$description: Height of the on-screen USE target, in mm (114 canvas px on the iPhone 14 Pro Max).

use-size-min.$description: The USE target is never smaller (9.6 mm).

pause-size.$description: PAUSE at 44 pt, inside the safe area, clear of the Dynamic Island.

move-zone.$description: The floating move pad catches touches over this share of the screen width, from the left.

motion.$description: UI motion (6.1). Under REDUCED MOTION, hover and focus change colour only, panels and screens fade without moving, and idle stops.

press.$description: A button or tappable dips; its sound plays. Starts on the input frame.

in.$description: UIMotion's lift tween (today it runs both ways).

out.$description: Proposal for the way back; the game keeps focus.in both ways until this is approved.

panel.$description: Tab switch, drop-down, dialogue box in. Exits are shorter than entries.

screen.$description: Title to Settings, pause open (today's pause reveal is 120 ms).

stagger.$description: Title buttons after the logo: the whole group lands within this; any input completes it.

idle.$description: Logo blink, rule sweep, light flicker: slow and irregular. Each wait is picked between period-min and period-max. Start picked for the mockups (the brief has it UNSET; M03 sets it).

sweep.$description: How long the title rule's idle glint takes to cross the rule: about twice the logo bar's BAR_SWEEP_SECONDS (1.1 s), so an idle tick never reads as the loading sweep (M03 review).

reduced-pulse.$description: Under REDUCED MOTION the loading sweep becomes an opacity pulse with this period (1 Hz or slower).

timing.$description: Screen fades, cards and the loading indicator (section 5).

fade.$description: Screen fades: RETRY today, door-led room changes and Continue (B22).

hold.$description: Dark hold between out and in on a room change.

control-return.$description: Share of the fade-in after which control returns.

resume-card.$description: Continue: today's top card restyled (room name and objective) over the paused room.

hold.$description: Closes on any input or after this.

guard.$description: Input is swallowed for this long after it shows (0.6 s is the title's guard).

first-visit.$description: A room's name on its first visit, over live play; never blocks input, no tips.

hold.$description: Same as the resume card, so one hold is learned.

min-show.$description: Once shown, stays at least this long. Also a loading card's minimum show.

quiet.$description: No indicator while the whole wait (from the logo's first frame) is under this: a begin() waits until this minus delay at the earliest, so a skip never brings a line (5.1 'No indicator under about 1 s').

loading-view.$description: The loading view, only for a slow load (5.6).

delay.$description: No loading view under about 1 s.

percent-after.$description: Past this, a real percent joins the indicator.

input-repeat.$description: Held D-pad and stick repeat in menus (pads send no echo events). Start picked for the mockups (the brief has it UNSET; M08 and M09 set it with a real pad).

keep-revert.$description: WINDOW MODE and WINDOW SIZE ask "Keep or revert?" and go back on their own after this (3.1 step 8).

com.mrdemonwolf.wolfoverride.source: brief 3.1 step 8; KSU; verify R2 #24 (a sensible default, not a Windows standard)

hold-confirm.$description: Hold to confirm (RESTORE DEFAULT CONTROLS, RESET ALL SETTINGS): how long the press is held before it confirms.

com.mrdemonwolf.wolfoverride.source: brief 3.2 (hold to confirm, CELESTE14; no length given); 2.0 s matches the bypass hold (bypass_handle.gd, gap-5), so one hold length is learned; XAG107 flags holds of 2 to 3 s

loading.$description: The loading view (M04, slow loads only) and the loading card (M04b): brief 5.6 and 7.3.

dim.$description: Opacity of the dark layer over the next room's plate, so the plate shows at about 45% and stays darker than the room it reveals (one dark dip).

pulse-peak.$description: Under REDUCED MOTION, the pulsing line's highest opacity; below 1, so a still of the pulse never looks like the finished line, which shows at full opacity (5.9).

dialogue.$description: The one dialogue box (6.3, B10): conversation, bark and system hint. Row length and reading speed live in i18n/languages.json; MAX_ROWS in dialogue_boxes.gd.

backing.$description: Opacity of the box backing; the DIALOGUE BACKING setting's default.

box.$description: Box height at the desktop profile, 100%.

height-portrait.$description: With a portrait: about 25% of the screen.

portrait.$description: Speaker portrait (placeholder crops until B24 is settled).

text-speed.$description: TEXT SPEED choices, in characters per second (Instant shows the line at once).

punctuation-pause.$description: Pause at . ? ! while typing, skipping abbreviations.

auto-advance.$description: AUTO-ADVANCE (off by default): reading time from reading_cps.

input-guard.$description: Input is ignored this long after an auto-advanced line.

bark.$description: Walk-and-talk lines as a bubble over the speaker; timed; never take USE.

alert.$description: Alerts are light, not sound (6.5, B9).

beacon-rate.$description: Beacon pulse, in flashes per second. FLASHING LIGHTS Reduced makes it a steady glow.

flash-area-max.$description: Share of the screen that may flash at once: 25% of any 10-degree field, about 120 x 120 canvas px (computed; assumes the WCAG reference screen fills the same view).

large-flash-area.$description: A flash covering this share of the screen or more counts as large.

large-flash-swing-max.$description: A large flash keeps its brightness swing under this.

red-ratio.$description: R / (R + G + B) at or above this is a red flash: fade it in and hold, never strobe.

devices.$description: Reference screens for the mockups and headless tests only; the game reads the real screen. Canvas size, view and camera are computed from these by the 2.5 formulas, never stored.

aspect-min.$description: Screens taller than 4:3 get top and bottom bars (2.5.2 rule 1). The wide bound (2.4:1) is computed from the room width, the play zoom and the canvas height.
